title: HTTP/1.1 request message
summary: An HTTP/1.1 request is a start-line, header fields, an empty line, then an optional message body. The start-line is 'METHOD SP request-target SP HTTP-version CRLF'.

ext.summary: An HTTP/1.1 request is a start-line, header fields, an empty line, then an optional message body. The start-line is 'METHOD SP request-target SP HTTP-version CRLF'.
notes: Start-line: METHOD SP request-target SP HTTP-version CRLF.
Header section: field-name ':' OWS field-value OWS, each terminated by CRLF; empty line (CRLF) ends headers.
Message body length determined by Transfer-Encoding (chunked) or Content-Length.
Connection semantics: keep-alive by default in HTTP/1.1.
